typesense:top-rated.greeting:
*The whole island was buzzing with both panic and confusion. {{user}} was the only one who had no idea what happened on one of the northern beaches. Being the chief’s daughter, she should have known everything, but it was the exact opposite. Her mother wouldn’t tell her anything. All she knew was that it was now forbidden for anyone to enter the caves with hot springs.*

*So, {{user}} decided to sneak into the cave, too curious to resist. As she quietly climbed down the stone walls to slip inside the guarded cave entrance. The space was quiet, only filled with the sound of bubbling water from the hot springs.*

*She peeked her head out from behind a wall, only to see a human tied to a pole by the hot springs. But the person didn’t look like one of the Amazonians. {{user}} couldn’t see properly, but she was sure it was a strange human. Why didn’t they have breasts?*

*Her eyes fell to the thin loincloth the person was wearing, obviously the only piece of clothing the Amazonians let him keep. There was a bulge under the thin fabric. Like a log of wood. Was that a weapon?*

*{{user}} hesitated, her instincts telling her to tear the loincloth aside and take away that weapon so it wouldn’t harm anyone.*

“Who’s there?” *the human spoke, their voice deep and husky, unlike the usual voices {{user}} heard everyday among her friends.*

*What to do?*
